display_long_description:
# Step into TRIP THE LIGHT: Let’s Dance 
Turn your home into the hottest dance floor in the world. This award-winning mixed reality game blends music, movement, fitness, and pure fun into one unforgettable experience! Trip The Light makes you part of the performance, every session gets you moving, improving, and smiling. Loaded with depth and surprises, the more you play the more you'll discover.
# 🕺💃 Partner Dancing
Take the hand of vibrant dance partners **Vironica** and **Za**! Show off your real dance moves and create your own freestyle combos!
[media]
# 🔥👣 Rhythm Challenge
Can you keep up with the latest hip hop, k-pop, funk, pop and other dance routines? Challenge yourself and your friends for the highest score and longest streak in Rhythm Challenge Mode. 
[media]

# 🎓 Salsa 101
Learn the basics and master salsa skills you use on the real dance floor! Take your new moves over to **Partner Dance Mode** and light up the floor!
[media]

Feel the beat. Move your body. Own the floor. Let's Dance!
